question: Lohit river is a tributary of:
solution:
The correct answer is the __Brahmaputra__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Lohit River:**

 
 
• It is a river in China and India.
 
• The Lohit River is also known as the Zayu River.
 
• **Lohit River is a tributary to the Brahmaputra River. Hence, Option 4 is correct.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Dhola–Sadiya Bridge or the Bhupen Hazarika Setu, is a **beam bridge** in** India and spans the Lohit River.**
 
• The **Brahmaputra River** is a **transboundary river **that flows through Tibet, India, and Bangladesh.
 
• The **Brahmaputra river** is the 9th largest river by discharge and the 15th longest in the world.
 
• The **Brahmaputra river** is also called Dihang River in Arunachal Pradesh, Yarlung Tsangpo in Tibet and Luit Dilao in Assam.
